rendered: The NiTi wires were pulled in axial tension to applied strains of 5% and 10%[1]. Because of the shape-memory property of the NiTi alloy, these strains were maintained after unloading, which left the surface V2O5 film under "locked-in" mechanical strain. The Methods describe the wires being deformed in tension up to 5%[2] and 10% strains[3], with tensile deformation beyond that level not performed to avoid delamination of the coating. The wider range explored was 0−10%[4].
